name: audio_native_tts_flow
description: Speech from one text line: Qwen3-TTS 12Hz CustomVoice through the pure-ComfyUI audio lane — text in, wav out. WHAT it produces: the spoken wav artifact. HOW it runs: the single tts card stage composes through the card plane, so the {flow:} door submits ONE merged run (validate then start); the speak POST tool runs the same row in one call; the {model:} door or the bench drives the tts card directly. Knobs: text (required) — what to say; seed (optional) — voice sampler seed, overlaid onto the stage; omit it and the tts card's own default applies (a fresh take, minted per run).

seed.description: Optional. Voice sampler seed, range 0..2147483647 — omit for a fresh take (the card mints one).
